groups.title: Phase 1: the manoeuvres, one block each
groups.about: Single manoeuvres from Phase 1's runs, in the replica, each variant at its confirmed profile (the surround hold at the screens' profile, cohesion cutoff 40).

flights.title: Pass round, R, p 40 · s 18
flights.about: Aimed at full stick through the block at the street opposite, the formation flows round both sides of the building and is one group again before the next junction. This design passed every criterion.

flights.title: Pass round, R, p 75 · s 18
flights.about: A block twice as wide: the formation flows round both sides, and one drone is still apart from the others (ringed) when the next junction comes, so the reform fails. The commonest failure at p 60 and 75.

flights.title: Surround and exit, R, p 40 · s 18
flights.about: The surround Phase 2 flew: 6 s aimed through the block at the opposite street, so the formation wraps the building, then off down a side street. Watch the block's streets turn from dashed to solid as a feed previews each one: 8 of its 9 by the time the pilot turns off.

flights.title: Surround and exit, R, p 75 · s 18
flights.about: The same 6 s surround round a block twice as wide: when the pilot turns off, only 3 of the block's 6 streets have been previewed, and 2 are never seen. A useful surround here needs 20 s or more.

flights.title: Surround hold (45 s), R, p 50 · s 12
flights.about: S1's centring hold on the block's centre at the design's matched spread d*: the formation spreads into a ring round the building, every drone on its edge facing outward, and holds it. Phase 1's surround map is made of these.

flights.title: Pass round, B, p 50 · s 18
flights.about: Variant B: passing round a block-shaped building, drones are pressed into its facade (amber): the building being passed, not the one across the street, as in nearly all of B's contacts. R's buildings, steered round as cylinders, stay near the contact bar.

flights.title: Surround and exit, B, p 50 · s 12
flights.about: Variant B with 12 m streets: the longer ring round a block-shaped building is slow to go round (2 of its 5 streets previewed in 6 s), and a drone scrapes the building as the formation turns off at its corner.

groups.title: Block-hop walk, p 40 · s 18 (with losses)
groups.about: One of Phase 2's chains: the same blocks and exits in every condition, 10 minutes. In this walk the surround lost two drones to a collision in the replica and four in Unity, and in Unity the hold lost two as well; the other flights lost none.

groups.title: Block-hop walk, p 40 · s 24
groups.about: A typical walk at the wider streets. Half the blocks here are plazas (too small for a building), which every condition crosses by the streets.

groups.title: Informed search, p 40 · s 18
groups.about: A hidden target (star); each condition's pilot picks the exit with the most unseen street nearby, from what its own feeds have shown, and stops at the first sight within 80 m. The swarm in the streets and the pass find it in about 2 minutes, the surround in 2.4, one drone in 6.5.

groups.title: Informed search, p 40 · s 24
groups.about: A target the usual order does not hold for: the hold finds it first (3.3 min), one drone next (5.0), and the street-bound swarm last of the swarm conditions (6.8). Whoever happens to look down the right street first wins.

groups.title: Looking down a block, p 40 · s 18
groups.about: One block from Part A, flown six ways from the same start, with the same seed and the same exit (the arrow). The squares are the buildings at the far ends of the block's other streets, filled once a shown feed has seen the footpath in front of one: looked down. Part A's rule picked a firm-hold surround of 6 s at d_ref 1.8 for this design (safe, inside the time price). The hold and the pass fly the same spread; Phase 2's surround flies its own setting, aim and turn for 6 s at Phase 1's d*. This trial is the one whose surround-minus-street difference in exits looked down is nearest the design's median over 30 trials. The lone drone takes the same exit by the shorter way round.

flights.about: By its decision at 12 s it had looked down 3 of the block's 7 exits with a building at the end (entered 4 of 7), and 3 by the next junction, 18 s after arriving at the block.

groups.title: Search for a goal at a building, p 40 · s 18
groups.about: Part B: the target (star) stands on the footpath in front of a building, as a goal does. Each condition's pilot heads for the exit with the most unseen footpath ahead, from what its own feeds have shown (the dots: footpath seen), and stops at the first sight within 250 m. This target's surround-over-street time ratio (1.17) is the nearest to the design's median (1.19).
